title: The migration and generation gates the round-four evaluation hardened (no agent)
expectation: Each check reproduces a failure an agent hit, or could hit, in the round-four evaluation, and asserts the CLI now fails closed or recovers deterministically. Every check works on a private copy of the fixture, so the checks are independent of each other.

checks.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r . "$d" && cd "$d" && python3 -c "import json; p='migrations/publications.json'; d=json.load(open(p)); [v.__setitem__('history', []) for r in d['receipts'] for v in r['versions'].values()]; json.dump(d, open(p, 'w'), indent=1)" && pina migrations check
checks.why: A receipt without schema pins cannot tell a rewritten published schema from the shipped one, so blanking pins must never make a check pass.

checks.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r . "$d" && cd "$d" && cp migrations/publications.json /tmp/pinned-original.json && python3 -c "import json; p='migrations/publications.json'; d=json.load(open(p)); [v.__setitem__('history', []) for r in d['receipts'] for v in r['versions'].values()]; json.dump(d, open(p, 'w'), indent=1)" && pina migrations reconcile --pin-legacy && cmp migrations/publications.json /tmp/pinned-original.json && pina migrations check
checks.why: Pinning an untampered manifest must reproduce the receipts byte for byte and leave a consistent history.
A body written for one draft layout compiled silently against the next one and corrupted accounts; it must now move aside behind a build-blocking stub.

checks.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r . "$d" && cd "$d" && python3 -c "p='src/lib.rs'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace('\tpub count: u64,', '\tpub count: u64,\n\t/// Revision.\n\tpub revision: u32,', 1); open(p, 'w').write(s)" && pina migrations create >/dev/null && pina migrations create --manual revision --no-interactive && grep -q TODO\(pina-manual-migration\) migrations/transitions/account_1_01/v0_to_v1.rs && grep -q '"mode": "manual"' migrations/manifest.json
checks.why: `--manual` on an unchanged automatic draft used to be ignored without a word.

checks.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r . "$d" && cd "$d" && rm -rf migrations && pina idl
checks.why: Without a manifest an auto policy compiles envelope-free; an IDL generated then would give every client the wrong wire format.

checks.command: pina skill read pina && pina skill read migrations && pina skill read cli-and-codegen
checks.why: The skill must tell an agent what these states mean before it meets them.
